Behind Chennai's water supply and sewerage systems are women engineers taking on challenging responsibilities and leading teams.
For the first time since its inception, Chennai Metrowater has women occupying key leadership positions, including Chief Engineers and Engineering Director posts. Women account for nearly 56% of the workforce, which includes 218 women engineers.
In this video, we meet the women steering Chennai's water and sewerage services as they reflect on their professional journey, challenges and achievements.
Thank you for watching our video!
